summary: Yeh Raaste Hain Pyaar Ke is a Hindi film released on 10 August 2001, directed and produced by Deepak Shivdasani, with Pradeep Sadarangani as co-producer. The note lists its writing, screenplay, music, cinematography and editing credits, and the lead cast of Madhuri Dixit, Ajay Devgn and Preity Zinta.
